challenges.text: Identification parade conducted after undue delay - reliability questionable
Stolen property not recovered from accused - possession not proven
Victim testimony has material contradictions with FIR
No evidence of force used - essential element of robbery missing
Weapon allegedly used was common household item, not deadly weapon
Accused has credible alibi - was at different location during crime
CCTV footage is too unclear to positively identify perpetrators
Fingerprints at scene could have been left during legitimate visit
